notes.title: Supersonic Tank Cats is out of Early Access
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=0k3qra7bWDw;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello everyone! It's been a long time, and I'd like to thank all of you that have been here being part of this. I cannot believe myself that this day is here. Enjoy Supersonic Tank Cats v1.0!

Since the last Early Access update, there's been A LOT of fixes and tweaks, so let's see the chagelog:

 Added remainding Boost Challenge missions
 Added Steam Cloud save
 Added achievements
 Added slight camera roll on drift
 Changed mercy invincibility time from 0.5s to 1.5s
 Reduced effect of stage hazards
 Adjusted Rainbow Paw formula so it takes into consideration actuall track progress along with position
 Slightly reduced Rokkit's maximum speed and acceleration
 Slightly increased Mao's maximum speed and acceleration, and slightly reduced his turning
 Reduced motion blur strength
 Made shotgun weapon shots' effect not linger around for half a second
 Fixed shotgun weapon hit bug when hitting other characters
 Fixed bug on trying to exit mission menu
 Fixed bug on cup results screen
 Added aditional fall areas to Icy Slide to prevent exiting the scenery
 Added small bridge ramps on bridge-to-ground spots in Misty Peaks
 Fixed token placement in Misty Peaks
 Tweaked wall on Luminous Lake after blue boostpad shortcut
 Fixed bug on cup select that would only unlock next cup if the previous one was beat on easy
 Fixed bug with Misty Peaks bridge collission
 Changed music credits name to No Quedan Héroes
 


Of course if you find any other bug, you can comment in the forums and I'll work on fixing it!

Thank you all, for finding time for these cats that are also tanks, in the middle of the complicated times we're living. Stay safe, and have fun!

notes.title: New beta branch update
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

First of all I want to thank you for reading this, in the worrisome times we're living. Stay safe!

Now, this new beta branch update features the following changes:

 Can now exit the cup results screen
 New fall areas outside of Icy Slide battle arena
 Small ramps on bumps in Misty Peaks track
 Fix on boolean values in cloud saving
 Slightly tweaked some character stats
 There's now three achievements from winning each cup in any difficulty!

Remember these changes only affect the beta branch for now! But the real v1.0 is coming soon. :)

Thank you and have fun!

notes.title: The wholesome update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30495681/bd9f73a4d7286c60d149df084eeb72601fe8bb01.png

Hello everyone! How're you?
It feels like it's been ages since last time I came with an update. It's been months.
As you know, a lot of stuff has happened this year, and here in Spain, we've had it rough. I'm lucky and grateful to say I haven't been personally affected.

But enough of that for now, we're here to see the new update. :)

The first thing you'll notice is the brand new intro animation! It's short, intense and cartoony, and it's been a blast learning while working on it. I hope you like it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30495681/d2d28d856a7b9f53d3874c7981b159c4a829c48c.png
The second novelty is the Kitty Playground mode: A chill place where you pat cats on their head or play with them with toys. Every time you enter there's a different selection of tank cats!

And, of course, there's three new characters to finish up the roster!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30495681/863c2df2817619cbc8a683775e95c3b3b5cd779a.png
Meet Luna, Geiger and Bakeneko! They're very different from each other, but they're good kitties in their own ways.

Other things added to this version are new missions, a third Grand Prix cup, and looooots of tweaks and fixes. Want to see them all? Here's the patch notes:

 Added Kitty playground: a mode in which you can pat the kitties and play with them
 Added new characters: Luna, Geiger and Bakeneko
 Added several Boost Challenge missions
 Added animated introduction sequence
 Added new grand prix: The Whisker Cup
 Removed all netcode from game, for optimization purposes
 Pause and results menus now use same key bindings as rest of the menus
 Fixed bug when exiting remap controls scene with ESC key
 Shotgun hitbox now shouldn't interfer with player movement
 Given the ice trap visible ice spikes to make it easier to see in bright areas
 Greatly reduced homing laser's stun time
 Reduced the strength of lasso weapon
 Slightly reduced Calico's stats
 Slightly increased Mao's stats
 Reduced the big missile explosion push force
 Halved bubble shield time
 Reduced fire trail boost duration
 Tweaked boostpad force in Thunder Heights before big jump
 Added patrons and collaborators to credits


And now, with all of the update news explained clear, I want to add something very important.
Next update will most likely be v1.0, and make the game exit Early Access. For that reason, I ask you for your feedback. I want to make next update mostly fixes and polish, to make the game as smooth as possible, and as close as the experience you want as I can make it be.
Any hiccup, balance issue, or strange looking corner, I want to fix in the next update, so don't be shy about bringing them up in the community forum. There's a thread for that. :)

It's been about three years since this project started, and sometimes it's been hard to continue... but I'm happy to have reached this point with you guys.

Take care in these strange times we're living, and have fun.

notes.title: The dark update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30495681/ccbc02cc64232c2920ff9e38a95270492c36789c.png

Hi everyone! First of all, I want to wish you happy holidays. Now, to make things quick, here's what this update is all about!


 New track: Bakeneko's mansion
 Changed how reverse speed is limited to allow faster bounces off walls
 Increased reverse speed limit from 10% of max speed to 15% of max speed
Now you need to press (and hold) drift while already turning in a direction
Drifting direction is fixed on start of drift
Turning against drift will allow you to reduce the drift turn, but not cancel it
Drifting now only slows you half as much as before
Drifting boost rewards now don't depend on your current speed, and depend solely on drifting time (capped at around 4 seconds)
Added ind/ividual bloom setting in options
Added new language: simplified chinese
Removed Online button from main menu
Sea Mines' explosions now last half as much in the scene and push a bit less
Fixed Orbital Blade, Shield and Rainbow Paw interfering with scenery collission


As you can see here, I've taken into account numerous points from your feedback, and hope the game is closer to the experience you all want to have when playing Supersonic Tank Cats. :)

Thank you, and have fun!

notes.title: Coming in the next update
notes.content:
Hi everybody!

Developing a game is hard work that takes some time, but I didn't want to leave you waiting for too long! So I'm presenting a small peek at the next update, that will bring a new track and many fixes and tweaks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30495681/63248ccbf51df1d5479cf4de656caee5b96db408.gif

Beware of Bakeneko's Mansion! A cursed japanese mansion full of fire and spirits, and surrounded by haunting bamboo forests lit by fireflies! And when I say cursed, I really mean it...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30495681/7b670fd16756f4654daaa4474800aeabf5130c11.gif

Be careful with these wandering souls! They're adorable, but dangerous!


And also, some very needed tweaks and fixes are coming: Shield, Orbital Blades and Rainbow Paw now won't affect collission with scenery, bouncing off a wall will now leave you further away from it and reverse speed now won't have a hard cap. Controlling your cat will be easier and smoother!

I'm still adding small fixes to the game, so if you have any problem with balancing or know of any janky spot in a track, let me know in the comments and I'll work on it. :)

Thanks, and have fun!

notes.title: Nuclear update is live
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Today's update is a mixed bag. I'll start with the good news!
https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/62c2e859-51a1-46d3-822a-59d70e047cb1/ddfp2u2-4d379056-eded-42b3-8fd2-1f9fbb882a75.gif?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..ByMg73lfhz_ryojpS7PLrKvpYrIk1KWJV3NEhi4SFmE

This new track is full of alternate paths and open areas so you can choose your way around! Find the fastest route, or take the safest path around the mutant poison-spitting plants and toxic waters in Luminous Lake!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30495681/a77438074d3c30ed52b5d8c2dce3e2c636348ded.png

The new character is a very special guest: Guapo, from Hyperbeard's Kleptocats!
Kepp an eye out for this little prankster! He might steal your heart!

On to sadder news, online multiplayer has been buggier and more unstable with each update that added content. Making an online game that just works is a big feat, one that requires lots of hard work, expertise, and dedicated staff. Sadly, I haven't been able to fix it in time for this update.
Since the start of development, a lot of things have changed in the game development world, with online frameworks being born and phased out. At this point I as a developer I'm facing a situation in which documentation for the exact version of the online systems I'm using is scarce and in some cases, support simply has dissapeared. As a result, I'm forced to take a step back and see how to tackle this problem in a different way. For now the mode is disabled, as it's almost non-functional at this point.
While I want the game to reach it's maximum potential, this specific part of development has been taxing on my own health and energy for a long time, and we're at a point of inflexion.
Up until today, I've still taken shots at fixing this mode, but right now, the best route is removing online play. I will, of course, keep you all posted if a solution is found, although for my own health I'm switching focus to adding content instead, and the most probable outcome is that I don't go back to online mode.

I want to apologize, too, to those who bought the game solely in hopes of getting an online experience. I've been feeling bad about it for a long time, and I hope you all are understanding with the difficulties and limitations of solo (almost-solo, technically) game development.

Without further delay, here's the changelog:

	New guest character: Guapo from Kleptocats
	New track: Luminous Lake
	Made Rainbow Paw weapon require usage instead of being automatically used on pickup
	Changed fullscreen settings for better compatibility
	Added Kryat Lore from patreon to Special thanks in credits
	Online mode has been disabled while the whole system is undergoing an overhaul
	Tweaked Rainbow Paw hitbox so it doesn't interfere with scenery as much
	Fixed UI bug on unlock window that didn't properly show "1st", "2nd" and "3rd"

notes.title: "Lan Party" Update now live!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30495681/0ee9d79e4784cadcd2bb860bb0fe0f5444b2e043.png

Hello everyone! It has been a while, hasn't it? This has been the hardest update to pull off so far. Hopefully, everything's easier from here! This update lands the foundations for online play. You can play LAN based races from 2 to 8 players, and with some tinkering, use that to play over internet.
There's also a few new quality of life improvements, and some bug squashing. Without more ado, here's the patch notes:

 Added the first version of online multiplayer
 LAN races are now supported
 IP of the race host is auto-detected when joining a game
 Added weapon icons to character selection screen
 New splash screen that should fix the restart bug
 Added track preview music


Next update will bring at least a new character and track, plus a feature that's been sorely missing until now: Minimaps!

Thank you and don't forget to share any bug you find in the forums so I can fix them for you. Have fun!

notes.title: The "Thunderbolt" update is live!
notes.content:
Hello everybody! It's a good time for an update, just in synchrony with the Black Friday sale. A new track, a new character, and lots of tiny fixes!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30495681/116460185605d40909658eef76db6ab1496ce83a.gif
Thunder Heights is a fast, adrenaline-pumping track! Suspended in the air, in the middle of an electric storm... oh, and there's a huge tornado up there, too.
It is temporarily using the battle mode music theme, but a dedicated one is in the works. Sorry for this small delay!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30495681/012ec399843aad8f142e7a524263ec6ebf372fe0.gif
Mao the chef is a mixed bag! He gets two ways of placing obstacles behind, in the form of landmines and his signature Fire Trail, which doubles as a speed boost!

Without ado, here's the full patch notes:

	Added a new circuit: Thunder Heights
	Added a new character: Mao
	Added shockwave effect when using boost pads
	Changed boost sound effect
	Changed Moona's fireballs sound effect
	Improved music in Pawn's Road and The Bowl tracks
	Tweaked acceleration to be easier accelerate from lower speeds
	Roam mode now has music
	Added a check to prevent "Double boost" from ramps with several booster pads besides each other
	Fixed bug that prevented from changing music, sound volume and brightness as a result of the new options menu layout
	Fixed bug that prevented Moona to emit step sounds
	Fixed bug that made jumping off ramps have inconsistent results


I'm planning on adding another character, plus a few new interesting features, in the next update. As always, thank you and have lots of fun!

Hello everybody! It's taken a while, but just in time for a spooky Halloween, we get the Dark Library arena map, along with the cutest fireball-shooting kitty, Moona!

notes.title: "The Bowl" Update is live!
notes.content:

Hello to everyone! After weeks of hard work, I'm proud to present you the first big update to Supersonic Tank Cats! The "Bowl" update, which comes with a new short-and-fast track, a new mechanic to make comebacks more likely and exciting, and tons of quality-of-life improvements. Without further ado, here's the patch notes:

New track: The Bowl!
Added the supermode system!
Added credits to title screen
Added small cooldown after shooting
Added the joystick triggers as alt for acceleration and backwards movement
Added "Brightness" to options
Added a button guide at first play and in the options menu
Divided options menu in categories
Reduced bloom intensity
Changed icon of homing missile
Results menu is not responsive for the first 0.15 seconds after appearing so you won't accept an option by mistake
Capped boost gotten from going down slopes to 25% of max boost
Revised grip mechanic so nobody slides for too much on ground and ramps work better at lower speeds
Made electric balls weapon easier to use (bigger damage area and not bouncing off players)
Changed the camera during countdown so you can see the track sign
Fixed a bug that wouldn't allow to play free-roam in the Sugarfire Park track


Want to see more while the game updates? Here's a few screenshots of the new circuit, you can even spot the new "super weapon" in use in one of them!

As always, thanks for playing! Have fun!

notes.title: Small fixes patch out!
notes.content:
I'm working on a juicy update with new content, but for the time being, I present you with some necessary fixes.

-The pause menu now is smaller and shows correctly on splitscreen multiplayer.
-Multiplayer Battle Mode now doesn't glitchs at the end of the match.
-Physics tweaked to evade excessive sliding on slopes.

Also, what's coming in the first update? At the very least, expect at least a new track and character, plus a few quality of life improvements:
-Brightness control on options menu
-Remappeable controls (+Trigger alt for acceleration)
-A new comeback mechanic to help those in last positions in a race or in their last health point in battle!
